changelog:
Old Device Revival. Minimum drops to Android 5.0 (API 21), targetSdk 36 unchanged. Full voice satellite on old tablets, Echo screens, headless Android 5/6 devices. Compose UI, ESPHome, Sendspin, scene floating windows validated on API 21.

VS Wake Word loads on Android 5. ONNX Runtime rebuilt with minSdk 21. Micro and VS engines both selectable. APK stays ~16.6 MB, zero feature cuts.

Wake engine switching fully fixed. Each engine stores words independently. Switching auto-restores last selection. Cross-engine aliases auto-map. HA no longer wipes options. Service auto-restarts on switch.

Android 5–6 note: legacy hardware varies. Wake recognition may glitch on microphone driver quirks or limited compute. Bluetooth gateway can be unstable. Match capabilities to device—core voice satellite is priority.

Stability fixes: scene floating windows and RenderScript crashes resolved via BlurCompat software rendering. Shizuku card hidden on Android 5 (needs API 23+). Settings debug pull-handle lengthened for better reach.
